Name: ZH's Artisanal Goods Plus - Stardew Valley Expanded
Author: ZoeyHoshi
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/G5GjjII.png[/img]﻿﻿
﻿[/center]
﻿﻿
Add-on mod for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29535]ZH's Artisanal Goods+[/url] for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/46021252]FlashShifter[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url], it can be used without [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29535]ZH's Artisanal Goods+[/url]﻿ but made to match with it.

This mod, like my others, is completely [i]configurable[/i]. Anything you don't like or want, you can simply disable alongside choose what style and colour you want.

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/lcEmWaN.png[/img]﻿
For anyone that may be wondering, this is what's[i] [/i]covered in this mod:[/center][u][b]Animal Product:[/b][/u]
Camel Wool, Honey Jar

[u][b]Artisan Goods:[/b][/u]
Aged Blue Moon Wine, Birch Water, Blue Moon Wine, Butter, Fir Wax, Goose Mayonnaise, Sports Drink, Stamina Capsule, Yarn

[u][b]Cooking:[/b][/u]
Birch Syrup

[u][b]Potion:[/b][/u]
Aegis Elixir, Armor Elixir, Barbarian Elixir, Bombardier Elixir, Gravity Elixir, Haste Elixir, Hero Elixir, Lightning Elixir, Marsh Tonic

[u][b]Special Items:[/b][/u]
Super Joja Cola

This mod, like my others, is completely [i]configurable[/i]. Anything you don't like or want, you can simply disable alongside choose what style and colour you want.


[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/4fl2KWq.png[/img]﻿[/center]1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿.﻿
3. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for easy configurations
4. Download the main .zip file from this mod and install it
5. When starting the game for the first time since installing, use Generic Mod Config Menu to configure the mod to your liking

You're all done and ready to play.
